page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a narrow column of marginal notes at the far left edge (cut off and largely illegible on the scan). Running head at the top centre; page number at the top right. Signature mark at the foot right.

main_text.p: ue excommunicari, satanæ denique mancipari, qui extra Ecclesiam regnat. satanas, Deus huius seculi dicitur, 2 Corint. 4. 4. quia sese illi veluti Deo mancipárunt homines huius seculi. A Deo impetrata facultate, percutit Iobum, Iob. 1. 12. est spiritus mendax in ore omnium Prophetarum Achab, 1 Reguni 22.22. Apostolos appetiverat, &c. Luc 22.31. in Iudam proditorem ingreditur, 22.3. vt fulgur è cœlo cadit, Luc. 10.18. in Angelum lucis transformatur, 2 Cor. 11.14. Colaphis cædit Paulum, 12.7. impedit Paulũ, 1 Thess. 2 18 (satan. i. aduersarius, 1 Pet. 5.8.)
SATIATI, ne obliuiscamur Dei, Deuter. 8. v. 10 11. 1 Corinth. 10.30.
Satietas piorum, & impiorum dissimilis: Psal. 17.14 15. & 107.8.9. satiatur terrae cultor Pro. 12.11.
SATIETAS à Deo impiis negatur, Iob. 20.7. Hos. 28. Mich. 6. 14. Agg. 1.6. satietas vitanda. Prouerb. 25.16. V. Mat. 5.6. Luc. 1.53.

SATISFACTIONES Papisticæ stabiliuntur, vt satisfactores isti putant, Col. 1.24. (Vide PVRGATORIVM) evertuntur, Roman. 4.5. & 14.6. 2 Corinth. 5. v. 20. 21. Galat. 1.4. Coloss. 1.14. 1 Tim. 2.6. 1 Ioan. 4.10. (V. GRATIA: & REDEMTOR: & PVRGATORIVM.)
SATVRAT Deus obedientes, Deut. 11. 15. saturati ne Dei obliuiscamur, Deu. 6. vers. 11. 12. saturatus Israel relinquit Deum, 32.15. (saturis væ, & quare, Luc. 6.25.) V. Ier. 5.7.
SATVARI, Phil. 4.12. & inebriari, Gen. 43.34. Esa. 55.10. Iere. 31.25. Hebraeorum more non significat ingurgitare, sed tantum sumere, quantum satis est.

SAVL filius Cis, quærit asinas patris, 1 Sam. 9.3. vngitur in regem, 10.1. prophetat, 10,10. & 19.23. percutit Philistheos, 13.4. offerens holocaustum peccat, v. 11. Domino altare extruit, 14.35. reseruato Agag, in Deum peccat, 15.8. regno expellitur, v. 23. à spiritu nequam exagitatur, 16 14. & 18. 10. Dauidem timet, ver. 12. eum occidi iuber, 19.1. in Ionathan filium, Dauidis causa excandescit, 20 30. sacerdotes occisi iubet, 22.18. in desertum Maon Dauidem persequitur, 23.25. Pythonissam adit, 28 8 seipsum interficit, 31.4. 1 Parali. 10.4. cur à Deo occisus, v. 13. eius ossa à viris Iabes Galaad sepeliuntur, 1 Sam. 31.13. à Dauide fletur, 2 Sam. 1. v. 12 17. filij eius in crucem aguntur, 2 Sam. 21.9.
SAVL de Rehoboth, rex Edom. [Gen. 36.37 31. Par. 1. v. 48.49
[Nepos Caathi, 1 Parali. 6.24. Nepos Iacobi ex Simeone.
